verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com with a structured index of the Mesh guides. Doc pages are served as raw markdown (.md) whose frontmatter includes an agentTools projectIndex pointing back to llms.txt, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema can be fetched without authentication. missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or comparable full-content bundle, first-party guidance on how to point agents at these docs.
